WITH customer_cohorts AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          CASE
              WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 'before_2026'
              WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR
                           FROM signup_date) = 2026 THEN 'in_2026'
              ELSE 'other'
          END AS cohort
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.customers`),
     cohort_orders AS
  (SELECT c.cohort,
          AVG(o.amount) AS avg_order_amount,
          COUNT(*) AS order_count
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` AS o
   JOIN customer_cohorts AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-10-10'
     AND LOWER(o.status) != 'cancelled'
     AND c.cohort IN ('before_2026',
                      'in_2026')
   GROUP BY c.cohort)
SELECT MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort = 'before_2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_amount_signed_up_before_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort = 'in_2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) AS avg_amount_signed_up_in_2026,
       MAX(CASE
               WHEN cohort = 'before_2026' THEN avg_order_amount
           END) - MAX(CASE
                          WHEN cohort = 'in_2026' THEN avg_order_amount
                      END) AS difference_eur
FROM cohort_orders;
